feedback.delta: Extend current semantic spine from cognition consistency != effect-time freshness != execution authority to a four-way separation that also includes outcome certainty/recoverability.

Golden traces need post-apply/pre-receipt crash, retry, UNCERTAIN/reconcile, changed-fingerprint same-operation-id, duplicate and concurrent recovery arms. Consume H-WP-02 version/event identities rather than duplicating its state ledger.

Selected mainline runtime 0.3 and current effect bridge do not visibly carry the prior effect_operation_id + semantic fingerprint + delivery/recovery class + UNCERTAIN contract. Integrate in typed IR/runtime ABI first; no syntax redesign is implied.

Durable effect intent/outcome lineage must distinguish dispatched operation identity from verified completion and preserve UNCERTAIN/reconciliation without inventing truth. Same-database effects may use one transaction domain; external sinks need explicit recovery class.
Graph-projected effect/outcome relations may surface UNCERTAIN and reconciliation dependencies but must never infer DONE from a proposal, dispatch or repeated retry ancestry.
Workspace/re-entry must represent outcome uncertainty as evidence state; GWT focus/broadcast cannot collapse an ambiguous external effect into success/failure.

Ambiguous post-crash external outcomes are a concrete set-valued alternative case: {effect_applied, effect_not_applied} may need to remain unresolved until sink evidence reconciles it. This is an engineering epistemic state, not quantum semantics.

Crash/retry/reconciliation changes intervention history; causal-emergence comparisons must bind effect operation and observation/recovery identity so duplicated effects are not misread as mechanism evidence.

Negative-result lineage closure may be required as an executable research-to-implementation traceability gate when fast concurrent workers replace candidates. Compare explicit lineage gating against ordinary regression review before promotion.

global_pattern: truth/provenance/authority/execution/outcome-certainty are related but non-identical semantic axes
